description: Efficient 15000-round V6 quality-threshold and Reward V3.8 experiment. V6 preserves the class-free 15-entry D4-canonical state and exact global bomb optimum, while its safe productive coin-route alternative is now admitted only when its discounted crate-yield score reaches at least 50 percent of the global optimum. The shortest-route and constrained-escape requirements remain unchanged. Reward V3.8 preserves the V3.7 hierarchy and invalid-action penalty of -0.70, changes selected-target bomb feedback from +0.20 to +0.30 and skipped-target feedback from -0.20 to -0.30, and multiplies the signed single-objective and joint safe-target navigation feedback by 1.5 from +/-0.040 to +/-0.060. True-conflict navigation feedback and all remaining rewards stay unchanged. Learning, exploration, TD target, seeds, checkpoints, and evaluation settings match the V6/V3.7 15000-round run.
